notes.title: Early Access Release Coming January 9th
notes.notes:
Early Access Release Jan 9th
After 2 years of development, we are releasing Starcade FACTIONS as Early Access on January 9th. We've taken the game through a Playtest, launched the Demo at Steam NEXT Fest, debuted at GSTAR Korea, and now we're ready to take it to the next phase with a wider audience by releasing in Early Access.

Taipei Game Show
Starcade FACTIONS will be shown live at Taipei Game Show. Since Starcade Arcade has a strong history with Taiwan's gaming scene through our partnership with HTC on the VR game Space Slurpies, we decided that Taipei Game Show was the perfect timing to release the  game as Early Access.

Early Access Replaces Demo
Starcade FACTIONS is and will always be a Free-to-Play game, so we are removing the Demo from the store. Interested users should just download the full game and enjoy the experience. All updated content will be apart of the Early Access release.

Launch Day Content
The game is already packed with lots of content to get started, including:

 Single player Tutorial and Gameplay
 Online PVP Matchmaking
 Private games with Friends
 3 Unique Factions to play
 30 different ships: 10 for each of the 3 Factions
 Multiple maps with unique modifiers

Wishlist or Download today!

Welcome to Starcade FACTIONS!
